Absolutely. The three sections shown are Programmes/Services, Branches, and Google Reviews. Here’s a detailed explanation you can use for your answer:

1. Programmes/Services

This section matters most because it immediately tells visitors what the organization offers and how it can help them. When someone visits a homepage, they usually want to know what services or programmes are available before exploring further. Clearly presenting them makes the website easier to understand, helps visitors find what they need quickly, and encourages them to take action, such as enrolling, applying, or contacting the organization.

2. Branches

The Branches section is important because it helps visitors determine where the organization is located and which branch is most convenient for them. Providing branch information such as locations, contact details, and possibly opening hours builds convenience and reduces the effort required to find a nearby location. It is especially important for organizations that serve people in multiple areas.

3. Google Reviews

Google Reviews matter because they provide social proof and build trust. New visitors may be unsure whether an organization is reliable or provides good-quality services. Seeing genuine feedback from previous customers can reassure them and influence their decision to choose the organization. Positive reviews also strengthen the organization’s reputation and can make visitors more confident about contacting or using its services.

Why these three deserve early placement

Together, these sections answer three of the visitor’s most important questions:

* “What do you offer?” → Programmes/Services
* “Where can I find you?” → Branches
* “Can I trust you?” → Google Reviews

That makes them valuable homepage sections because they provide information, accessibility, and credibility—three things that can strongly influence whether a visitor continues exploring or decides to use the organization.
column25:
The homepage hero should immediately communicate what the website is built for and help visitors understand what we do. That’s why I chose a short, real workout video as the hero media rather than using a generic image. It gives visitors an instant feel for the actual fitness environment, the workouts, and the overall experience.

Since the majority of our fitness audience is women, the hero also needs to address the things that influence their decision to join a fitness space. They want to feel that the place is clean, hygienic, welcoming, worth their investment, and genuinely capable of helping them achieve results.

A real workout video helps communicate this without relying only on words. It shows the energy and atmosphere of the space while making the experience feel more authentic and relatable. It also gives a potential member enough confidence to think, “This looks like a place I would actually want to try.”

Most importantly, the hero should communicate that we are not just about workouts or equipment. We are result-oriented while being community-driven—a place where members can work toward measurable fitness goals while also feeling supported and comfortable within the community.

column27:
Our Functional Training sessions are coach-led, energetic and designed around real-life fitness. Members work on strength, mobility, stamina, balance, coordination and fat loss using bodyweight, resistance bands, dumbbells, kettlebells, mats and other functional equipment. Sessions include a mix of strength circuits, HIIT, mobility and functional movements, with exercises modified according to individual fitness levels.

Members choose Functional Training because it is practical, engaging and results-oriented—without depending on heavy gym machines. Our difference is the personal attention, structured coaching and motivating community environment that helps members stay consistent while becoming stronger and fitter.
column28:
Our Zumba classes are high-energy, fun and beginner-friendly, combining easy-to-follow dance movements with cardio and full-body exercise. Members enjoy dancing to energetic music, burning calories, improving stamina and coordination, and working out without feeling like they are exercising.

It is especially popular with women, homemakers and working professionals who want an enjoyable way to stay active, lose weight and feel more energetic. Our difference is the friendly community, motivating trainers, simple choreography and non-judgmental environment where even beginners can confidently join and enjoy every session.
column29:
Our Yoga classes are calm, structured and beginner-friendly, combining traditional asanas, mobility work, breathing practices, relaxation and mindfulness. Sessions help members improve flexibility, strength, balance, body awareness and overall mental well-being while creating a peaceful break from their daily routine.

Members usually join to stay active, improve flexibility and mobility, manage everyday stress, build a consistent fitness routine and feel more relaxed and energetic. Our approach focuses on proper guidance, mindful movement and creating a comfortable environment for people of different fitness levels.
column30:
Our Dance classes are fun, energetic and designed for people who simply love to dance. Adult batches focus on learning popular dance styles and choreography in a relaxed, non-judgmental environment—making them a great way to stay active, express yourself and enjoy music with a community.

Ladies-only batches offer a comfortable, friendly space where women can learn, move and enjoy dancing together. Kids-only batches are designed around age-appropriate choreography, helping children build confidence, coordination, rhythm and stage presence while having fun.

Whether it’s for fitness, a hobby or simply the joy of dancing, our classes are inclusive, engaging and beginner-friendly.
column31:
Our Wedding Choreography service offers personalised dance performances for weddings and pre-wedding celebrations, created around the couple, family and friends. We first understand the event, participants, song preferences, dance experience and performance requirements.

Our choreographer then selects suitable songs, creates easy-to-learn choreography and teaches the group step-by-step through planned practice sessions. The choreography is customised to the participants’ comfort levels and can include couple performances, family dances and group performances.

The goal is to make everyone feel confident, coordinated and comfortable on stage, while creating a fun experience and memorable performance for the wedding.
column32:
Our Home Personal Training is designed for people who prefer privacy, convenience and one-to-one coaching at home. It is ideal for beginners, busy professionals, homemakers, seniors and anyone who wants more personalised attention than a group class.

We provide trainers across Navi Mumbai and Thane, subject to location and trainer availability. After understanding the client’s goals, fitness level, schedule and available space/equipment, the trainer creates a personalised workout plan and conducts one-to-one sessions at the client’s home.

The training is personalised in terms of exercise selection, intensity, pace, progression and session timing, with regular guidance to help clients stay consistent and work towards their individual fitness goals.
column33:
Our Online Training is designed for people who want professional fitness coaching from the convenience of home, regardless of their location. Sessions are conducted through Zoom and can be offered as live one-to-one personal training or structured small-group sessions, depending on the programme.

Members receive guided workouts, exercise demonstrations, corrections and coaching throughout the session. Training can be adapted to their fitness level, goals, available space/equipment and schedule, making it a convenient option for busy professionals, homemakers and people who cannot regularly visit a studio.

Membership Policy
Cancellation: Once a membership is purchased, cancellation is subject to the terms communicated at the time of enrolment.

Refunds: Membership fees are generally non-refundable and non-transferable once the membership has commenced, except where specifically approved by management.

Transfer Between Branches: Members may request to transfer their membership between Ankit’s Studio branches, subject to programme availability, applicable fee differences and management approval.

Freeze/Pause: Memberships may be paused/frozen only under eligible circumstances and with prior approval. The freeze period and applicable conditions will be communicated at the time of the request.

Membership Expiry: Memberships are valid only for the duration mentioned at the time of purchase and expire automatically on the stated expiry date. Unused sessions do not automatically extend the membership period.

Missed Classes: Missed classes are not carried forward, compensated or added to the membership period. Members are encouraged to attend according to the schedule selected at enrolment.

One thing I would change

For Cancellation + Refund, I would avoid saying simply “non-refundable” on the website unless that is genuinely your final policy in every situation.

column84:
Ankit’s Studio started with a simple belief: fitness should be accessible, enjoyable and sustainable—not intimidating or limited to traditional gyms.

Ankit wanted to create a space where people could improve their fitness through expert coaching, movement and community, without depending on complicated machines or a conventional gym environment. This led to the creation of Ankit’s Studio in Sector 19, Airoli, in 2019.

Over the years, the studio grew through the trust and support of its members, expanding to Sector 8A, Airoli (2021), Ghansoli (2023) and Thane (2026). What began as one studio has evolved into a growing fitness ecosystem offering Yoga, Zumba, Functional Training, Dance, Personal Training, Corporate Wellness and trainer education.

The journey has reinforced one core belief: when people feel comfortable, supported and motivated, fitness becomes a lifestyle rather than a short-term goal.
column85:
Our coaching philosophy is simple: fitness should be effective, enjoyable and sustainable.

We believe good coaching is not about pushing everyone through the same workout. It is about understanding the person, meeting them at their current fitness level, teaching them correctly and helping them progress consistently.

We focus on proper guidance, inclusivity, consistency and community, while making every session engaging enough that members genuinely look forward to coming back.
